collection.title: Rover Tourer 1994 to 1998 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Rover Tourer 1994 to 1998 model which requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
